captions.instagram:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone.

On that lab test, only 11.7% showed their main content within Google’s 2.5-second mark. But Google also has real-visitor data for about 23% of these sites, and among those, 59.9% passed.

The lab test is deliberately tough. It is a warning light, not a verdict. The honest check is your own homepage on a real phone.

captions.linkedin:
We tested 12,621 Australian small-business websites with Google Lighthouse on a simulated mid-range phone.

On that lab test, only 11.7% showed their main content within Google’s 2.5-second mark. It is easy to stop there and panic. But Google also publishes real-visitor data for about 23% of these sites (2,887 of them), and among those, 59.9% passed.

The lab test is close to a worst case, not what every visitor sees. I think a lab score is best read as a warning light, not a verdict. The real check is simple: open your own homepage on a real phone, on mobile data, and watch what loads first.

Full method: prycedigital.com/research
